_doc: Series-level rights claims a reader can open. Each hides every recording of the series (rec_rights_holder_claim) or every episode (work layer). Add an entry only with a source URL. Key: normalized series name (otr_parse.norm_series).

shadow.claimant: Advance Magazine Publishers (Conde Nast), licensed to Radio Spirits
shadow.basis: Published claim that the radio programs are its trademarked and copyrighted property; licensed 2017 CD release

loneranger.claimant: Lone Ranger Television, Inc. (scripts); exclusive radio licensee Charles Michelson Inc.
loneranger.basis: Scripts registered and renewed; infringement by duplicated radio tapes affirmed, Lone Ranger Television v. Program Radio, 740 F.2d 718 (9th Cir. 1984)

lumandabner.claimant: Chester Lauck estate, via Radio Spirits
